pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown patches. Edges exhibit sharp pixel gradients against light corridors. Patch spatial area is maximal on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes typically connect three to four patches. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent on the neck, becoming narrower and more intricate on the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette of the mane along the upper neck ridge. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Numerous raised, dark, textured nodules are visible on the lateral neck and upper shoulder, creating significant textural disruption to the dorsal ridge area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cutaneous nodules or verrucous-like lesions are visible across the neck and shoulder region.
other_distinctive_markers: A Yellow-billed Oxpecker is perched on the upper neck. A second giraffe's neck and head are partially visible in the bottom right foreground.
